title: The Crown Becomes the Bow
pitch: The crescent moon on her crown slides off, stretches into a sugarcane bow, and a flower arrow shot from it blooms into the lotus she sits on.
hook_first_second: A glowing crescent unhooks from her crown and bends like liquid metal.
beats: Crescent lifts off the crown and elongates into a green sugarcane bow
Bow string forms from a thread of moonlight
A flower arrow flies across the dark water
The arrow lands and blooms into the golden lotus under her
payoff: The weapon of desire and the seat of peace are the same object.
loop: The lotus petals close, curve into a crescent and settle back on her crown.
seed: Sugarcane bow and flower arrows; crescent moon crown (Sahasranama, Tripura Rahasya)
send_trigger: People send it as 'watch the crown turn into a bow'.

title: Liquid Gold Rises
pitch: A pool of liquid gold on black water climbs upward against gravity, folds itself into her face, then pours back down as she opens her eyes.
hook_first_second: Gold liquid lifts off the water in a single smooth column.
beats: Gold column rises and sculpts a cheek and brow
Features sharpen into her face, eyes closed
Eyes open, gold runs off like a mask into the water
payoff: A statue of liquid gold becomes a living face in one pour.
loop: Ripples converge to a point and the gold column rises again.
seed: Golden complexion (Tripura Rahasya golden form); radiance (Sahasranama v2)

title: Sixteen Phases, Sixteen Faces
pitch: The moon waxes through sixteen phases and each phase is a face of hers, from a sliver-eyed girl to the full-moon queen.
hook_first_second: A thin crescent blinks and is already a smiling face.
beats: Crescent becomes the face of a girl
Each waxing step ages the face and adds jewels
Full moon is Shodashi in her crown
Moon wanes back through the faces, shrinking to a crescent
payoff: The sixteenth moon is her; the whole month is one face growing up.
loop: The final sliver is the first crescent, restarting the count.
seed: Shodashi as the sixteenth lunar digit (Advaita-l thread, interpretive)
send_trigger: Tag a friend for each phase.

title: Mirror Hall of Ages
pitch: She walks through a corridor of mirrors; each reflection is a different age of the same goddess, ending with Bala at the far end holding a bow.
hook_first_second: Her reflection steps out of the glass a half-second before she does.
beats: Each next mirror shows a younger self, snapping into place
Infinite tunnel ends on small Bala
Bala raises a flower arrow at the camera
payoff: The goddess and the child are the same light at different sizes.
loop: Bala shoots; the arrow shatters the first mirror and the corridor rebuilds.
seed: Bala Tripura Sundari as child form (Lalitopakhyana retellings)
send_trigger: Mirror-tunnel hypnosis and a surprise ending.

title: Wheel Into Sri Chakra
pitch: A swan chariot wheel spins faster until its spokes fold into the nine interlocking triangles of the Sri Chakra, then the camera falls into the center point.
hook_first_second: A wheel on the water spins and its spokes bend into triangles.
beats: Chariot wheel on dark water spins
Camera dives into the center dot
Dot swells into a pupil in her eye
payoff: Her chariot, her home and her eye are one geometry.
loop: Her pupil reflects the swan wheel on the water; it begins to spin.
seed: Chakra Raja Ratha chariot; Sri Chakra as her body (Yoginihridaya via brhat.in)

title: Flames Freeze Into Petals
pitch: A roaring ritual fire freezes mid-lick, every flame turns to a golden petal and a girl in crimson rises from the pit as the petals bloom open around her.

Petals unfold outward in a ring
A girl of sixteen stands up out of the center
Petals fall and she steps onto water
payoff: The birth from the fire-pit of awareness, shown as a flower opening.
loop: Her step ripples; the petals curl back into flames.

title: Ash Remembers Being Love
pitch: Grey ash of burnt Kama lies on dark stone; Tripura's glance sweeps it, the ash lifts as fireflies and re-forms a young man holding a flower bow.

title: Mercury Pearl Crown
pitch: One pearl drops into the water, splits into sixteen pearls that rise and arrange themselves into her crown as it settles on her head.

Pearls rise on thin columns of water

title: The Red Ribbon Road
pitch: Her crimson silk noose-ribbon is cast across the void; it becomes a road, a river, a staircase and finally a wedding sash around the moon.

Road ripples into a red river
River folds into a staircase upward
At the top it ties around the moon
payoff: The noose of attachment becomes a path to the moon.
loop: The moon unties and the ribbon drops into her hand.

title: Cloud Elephant Taming
pitch: A black storm cloud takes the shape of a rampaging elephant; her goad touches it and it shrinks to a toy elephant that sleeps on her palm.
